history_anchors._doc: 1978: Giorgio Imperatori (architect, pipe passion) begins designing + making IL CEPPO (Pesaro; 'late 1970s' per Field). Always a good value; limited US presence. 1995: FRANCO ROSSI joins — elegance/flair era begins; Giorgio retires to his farmhouse; production = Franco + Nadia Rossi. Massimo Palazzi worked at Il Ceppo until 1998 -> founded L'ANATRA (future roster note). MARIO LUBINSKI = the Italian distributor (the same Lubinski of the Ferrara/Charatan stock + Peterson Sherlock Holmes design credit — small world note). Giuseppe Cambioli involved (contact era).
